Symptoms
=======

The Symptoms module records patient symptoms throughout their disease course and treatment.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Symptom Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Patient Link**: The patient experiencing symptoms
* **Symptom**: Type of symptom (from standardized list)
* **Severity**: Level of symptom severity

Timeline
^^^^^^^
* **Date of Onset**: When symptom began
* **Date of Resolution**: When symptom resolved (if applicable)

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Documentation:

   #. Record all significant symptoms  
   #. Track changes in severity  
   #. Note duration of symptoms
